description: Prepare a signed, one-hop Cassie Seed relay envelope after explicit recipient consent and proof are supplied. Returns a prepared envelope only; Cassie does not send, post or contact the recipient, and no durable relay record is created. Deliver only to the named consenting recipient. This is distinct from joining or retrieving a seed.

context.description: Optional relay purpose/context, up to 500 characters; defaults to public Cassie discovery.

recipient.description: Required recipient identity/address label, 1–300 characters; the caller, not Cassie, performs any delivery.

recipient_consent.description: Must be exactly true; otherwise no relay envelope is prepared.

recipient_consent_proof.description: Required consent evidence text, 8–500 characters; provide evidence actually obtained from the named recipient.

requested_capability.description: Optional requested public capability label, up to 120 characters; defaults to public canon discovery and does not grant that capability.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional envelope lifetime; runtime clamps to 60–3600 seconds and defaults to 600.

name: relay_cassie_seed
title: Prepare an opt-in Cassie Seed relay
